card.summary: 1 GB per listing (all files counted together) on paid/members-only products; 25 MB total for free digital products. 50 products on Free, 500 on Pro.

free_tier.stated: 1 GB per listing (all files counted together) on paid/members-only products; 25 MB total for free digital products. 50 products on Free, 500 on Pro.

egress.terms: No published egress cap; assets on cdn.fourthwall.com.

record.interface_detail: Documented developer API (docs.fourthwall.com) with signed URLs; the `size` you declare is enforced at URL issue time.
record.chaining: 1 GB x 500 products on Pro = 500 GB ceiling. The only provider here where the account product count, not the file size, is the binding number.
record.limits_note: per-listing 1 GB (aggregate across files). 50/500 product caps.
record.reliability_note: Developer docs note the declared size is enforced 'both when the URL is issued and by the signed URL itself'. Sending more bytes than declared fails the upload, which is the opposite of the usual under-enforcement pattern.

evidence.proved: 'Free digital products have a 25MB total file size limit per listing. Paid digital products support up to 1GB per listing'
'Digital files are size-limited per shop: 25 MB on free plans, up to 1 GB otherwise... sending more bytes than declared fails the upload'
